warnings: Page8 repeats core+door blocks; spatial dedup mandatory.
Duplex32 upper level6 has no separate hall entry; internal stair links levels5–6.
Two-cubic door arcs are approx98degree circular arcs whose fitted centre is offset from hinge; derive hinge and leaf width from thin leaf quad.
Roofpage11 is lift head only, with no passenger landing doors or car symbols.
Lift car dashed symbol rectangles are source plan symbols; no fabricated detailed cabin equipment is implied.
World fields use originalR44 registration, which offsets upperfloors by-.20m z. Use correctedRegistration controls before integration.
